parsed.rationale: Both records are unnamed `extension` declarations on (presumably) `UserDefaults` within the same `Caching` package, surfaced by the name-collisions query. Having two separate files in `Shared/Caching/Sources/Caching/` extend the same type fragments the API surface and makes it harder to reason about the full set of members added to `UserDefaults`. Consolidating both extensions into `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` (the file whose name already signals its purpose) eliminates the collision signal while keeping the extension scoped to the `Caching` package. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies.
